review_evidence: The unit contains 503 primary Lean files generated by the InstCombine extract-goals pipeline, each exposing an extracted theorem statement rather than non-formal test output.

Representative declarations include test_thm.extracted_1._1, both_thm.extracted_1._2, zext_masked_bit_nonzero_to_smaller_bitwidth_thm.extracted_1._1, covering fixed-width bitvector shifts, comparisons, casts, logical operations, or extension identities.

The files retain the logical obligations as named Lean theorems (typically with sorry bodies); generated provenance and test-tree placement do not make these distinct statements content-lossless to remove.
summary: Retain this InstCombine extracted-goals bucket: all 503 primary files are standalone bitvector/LLVM theorem obligations with independent formal benchmark and theorem-search value.
